verdict.rationale: Context.dev is a web scraping and crawling API, so routing requests through rotating proxy IPs is a fair question for it. However, no first-party doc in the pack mentions proxies, IP rotation, or a proxy pool. Community comments only ask whether it uses rotating or residential proxies; they neither confirm nor concretely contradict a documented capability, so the verdict stays none.

support.subject: As a developer, I can route requests through a rotating pool of proxy IPs to avoid blocks
